hebrewText: וְ/הָ/אֶ֣בֶן הַ/זֹּ֗את אֲשֶׁר שַׂ֨מְתִּי֙ מַצֵּבָ֔ה יִהְיֶ֖ה בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/כֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתֶּן לִ֔/י עַשֵּׂ֖ר אֲעַשְּׂרֶ֥/נּוּ לָֽ/ךְ

tokens.kjv: [phrase] carbuncle, [phrase] mason, [phrase] plummet, (chalk-, hail-, head-, sling-) stone(-ny), (divers) weight(-s).
hereby (-in, -with), it, likewise, the one (other, same), she, so (much), such (deed), that, therefore, these, this (thing), thus.
